---
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nf-core/modules/master/modules/environment-schema.json
channels:
  - conda-forge
  - bioconda
dependencies:
  - bioconda::isoseq=26.2.0

// Copyright (c) the nf-core community under an open-source MIT license.
// See https://github.com/nf-core/modules for full license, file patching instructions and upstream contributing.

process ISOSEQ_GROUPDEDUP {
    tag "$meta.id"
    label 'process_medium'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${ workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container ?
        'https://depot.galaxyproject.org/singularity/isoseq:26.2.0--h9ee0642_0' :
        'quay.io/biocontainers/isoseq:26.2.0--h9ee0642_0' }"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(bam)

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("*.dedup.bam")     , emit: bam
    tuple val(meta), path("*.dedup.bam.pbi") , emit: pbi
    tuple val(meta), path("*.dedup.fasta.gz"), emit: fasta
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('isoseq'), eval("isoseq groupdedup --version | sed -n '1s/isoseq groupdedup \\([0-9.]*\\).*/\\1/p'"), emit: versions_isoseq, topic: versions

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    isoseq \\
        groupdedup \\
        -j $task.cpus \\
        $args \\
        $bam \\
        ${prefix}.dedup.bam

    gzip ${prefix}.dedup.fasta
    """

    stub:
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    touch ${prefix}.dedup.bam
    touch ${prefix}.dedup.bam.pbi
    echo "" | gzip > ${prefix}.dedup.fasta.gz
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/isoseq/groupdedup"
description: "IsoSeq - GroupDedup - Deduplicate PCR artifacts grouped by cell barcode"
keywords:
- "dedup"
- "single-cell"
- "isoseq"
- "Pacbio"
tools:
- isoseq:
    description: "IsoSeq - GroupDedup - Deduplicate PCR artifacts grouped by cell\
      \ barcode (barcode-sorted FLTNC to DEDUP)"
    homepage: "https://isoseq.how/"
    documentation: "https://isoseq.how/"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/PacificBiosciences/IsoSeq/tree/master"
    licence:
    - "BSD-3-Clause-Clear"
    identifier: ""
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'test' ]\n"
  - bam:
      type: "file"
      description: "FLTNC BAM file generated by isoseq refine, sorted by cell barcode\
        \ (CB or XC tags)"
      pattern: "*.bam"
      ontologies: []
output:
  bam:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'test',\
          \ single_end:false ]\n"
    - '*.dedup.bam':
        type: "file"
        description: "BAM file of deduplicated consensus reads"
        pattern: "*.dedup.bam"
        ontologies: []
  pbi:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'test',\
          \ single_end:false ]\n"
    - '*.dedup.bam.pbi':
        type: "file"
        description: "Pacbio index of deduplicated consensus reads"
        pattern: "*.dedup.bam.pbi"
        ontologies: []
  fasta:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'test',\
          \ single_end:false ]\n"
    - '*.dedup.fasta.gz':
        type: "file"
        description: "Gzipped FASTA of deduplicated consensus reads"
        pattern: "*.dedup.fasta.gz"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1929"
  versions_isoseq:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - isoseq:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - isoseq groupdedup --version | sed -n '1s/isoseq groupdedup \([0-9.]*\).*/\1/p':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - isoseq:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - isoseq groupdedup --version | sed -n '1s/isoseq groupdedup \([0-9.]*\).*/\1/p':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
authors:
- "@mahesh-panchal"
maintainers:
- "@mahesh-panchal"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
license: "MIT License"
